title.narrative: Sustainable Livelihood in Sudan through Strengthening Accessibility Systems to Fresh Water

description.narrative: The workplan aims to address the urgently needed freshwater challenges in Sudan amid new conditions as a result of conflict and with a vision of Post-Conflict. It targets the changing demography as a result of migration and with scientific based decision making as a result of assessment and considering sustainment of peace in Sudan. The main focus will be the new capital of Sudan, Port Sudan City, that faces historically water scarcity and quality challenges. The workplan contributes to the priority areas of the ninth phase of the Intergovernmental Hydrological Programme (IHP-IX). Proposed activities include: 1. IWRM Network activation in Port Sudan, Red Sea State and Sudan 2. Seed money for supporting national coordination for rehabilitation and supporting the water sector in Sudan 3. Seed money for supporting Water Harvesting expansion in Red Sea State to address Water Scarcity Issues 4. Seed money for Water Governance in Port Sudan, Red Sea state and Sudan amid ongoing War Situation in Sudan 5. Seed money for new innovations that address water shortages and quality challenges
